whatThisIs: Counts device-days for an indwelling Foley catheter or central venous catheter. Enter the device and its insertion timestamp and it returns elapsed days and hours, then checks the CDC/SHEA daily-removal criteria you tick against that duration and flags the device for a removal conversation when none of them still apply.
whenToUse: Use it on daily rounds for CAUTI and CLABSI prevention, where the single strongest intervention is removing a line or catheter that no longer has an indication. The criteria list is the published one; whether an indication genuinely still holds is a clinical judgment the counter cannot make.
